import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

SEED = 42
TARGET = "Survived"
FEATURES = [c for c in df.columns if c != TARGET]

df = df.copy()
df["_row_id"] = df.index

def safe_split(data, test_size, seed, target):
    strat = data[target] if data[target].value_counts().min() >= 2 else None
    use_strat = strat is not None
    try:
        tr, te = train_test_split(data, test_size=test_size, random_state=seed,
                                  stratify=strat, shuffle=True)
    except ValueError:
        tr, te = train_test_split(data, test_size=test_size, random_state=seed,
                                  shuffle=True)
        use_strat = False
    return tr, te, use_strat

train_df, temp_df, s1 = safe_split(df, 0.40, SEED, TARGET)
val_df,  test_df, s2 = safe_split(temp_df, 0.50, SEED, TARGET)

for name, part in [("train", train_df), ("val", val_df), ("test", test_df)]:
    print(f"{name:<5}: {len(part)} rows | Survived={part[TARGET].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()} "
          f"| row_ids={sorted(part['_row_id'].tolist())}")

ids_train, ids_val, ids_test = (set(p["_row_id"]) for p in (train_df, val_df, test_df))
assert len(train_df) + len(val_df) + len(test_df) == len(df)
assert not (ids_train & ids_val), "train/val overlap"
assert not (ids_train & ids_test), "train/test overlap"
assert not (ids_val & ids_test), "val/test overlap"
assert ids_train | ids_val | ids_test == set(df["_row_id"])

print(f"\nSeed = {SEED}")
print(f"Split sizes  ->  train {len(train_df)} | val {len(val_df)} | test {len(test_df)}  (total {len(df)})")
print(f"Stratified: step1={s1}, step2={s2}")
print("✓ Splits are disjoint, exhaustive, and reproducible with the fixed seed.")

globals().update(
    SEED=SEED, TARGET=TARGET, FEATURES=FEATURES,
    train_df=train_df.drop(columns="_row_id").reset_index(drop=True),
    val_df=val_df.drop(columns="_row_id").reset_index(drop=True),
    test_df=test_df.drop(columns="_row_id").reset_index(drop=True),
)
print("\nFrozen variables ready: train_df, val_df, test_df, TARGET, FEATURES, SEED")
